narrative: Compassion Home Care Limited presents as a financially healthy, debt-free business with consistent profitability. However, the acquisition carries high execution risk due to the total exit of the management team (Director and Registered Manager). Furthermore, the 413% increase in trade debtors in the 2026 fiscal year requires urgent investigation to ensure revenue is being converted to cash and is not masking bad debt. The deal is viable but requires a robust management succession plan and a thorough audit of the current debtor book.
